s: See every client at a glance: their tier, payment status, this week's workouts and when they last trained.
b: Open the Clients tab at the bottom of the screen (on a laptop it's in the side menu). Your Clients lists everyone you coach. Each row shows their tier and price, whether they've paid, how many of this week's workouts are done (for example 4/4), their current meso and when they last trained. Use Sort to order the list by name or by who needs you most. A number next to a name means new messages or items to review. Tap a name to open that client. The badge on the Clients tab counts new messages from all your clients.

s: One list of who needs you today: missed workouts, failed payments, health checks, missing check-ins and more.
b: Open the Clients tab. Needs Attention is at the top. Each group shows a count, for example 2 Missed Workouts, 1 Payment Failed, 1 Health Check To Review or 1 No Check-In Last Week. Tap a group to see which clients are in it. Tap a name to open that client and deal with it. Groups clear on their own once the item is handled, for example when you mark a health check as reviewed. New Personal Bests is there too, so you can congratulate clients as well as chase them.

s: Everything about one client on one screen: their week, their meso, notes, health check and tools.
b: Open the Clients tab and tap a client. The top shows where they are in their meso (for example Week 4 of 5 + Deload), this week's workouts, when they last trained and any missed workouts. Use the buttons to start a New Meso, open Messages, a Video Call or Form Checks, or See As the client. Switch between Overview, Program, Check-Ins and Progress with the tabs. Scroll down for About, your private notes (Save Notes) and their Health Check. Your notes are private to you. The client never sees them.

s: See how many planned workouts each client completes every week, so you spot a slipping client early.
b: Open a client from the Clients tab. Weekly Consistency is the first card. It shows each week of their meso and how many of the planned workouts they did. A full week is shown with a tick. Missed and skipped workouts are counted separately, so you can tell a planned skip from a missed day. Tap a week to see which days were done. Consistency also feeds Needs Attention: a client who falls behind shows up under Needs A Nudge or Inactive.

s: Open the app exactly as your client sees it, to check their plan, their to-do list and your branding.
b: Open a client from the Clients tab. Tap See As (for example See As Liam). You now see their Train screen, their Things To Do Today and their meso, with your branding, just as they do. Nothing you look at is changed. Tap the banner at the top to go back to your own view. In Demo PT, open Liam (or any client) and tap See As to try it.

s: Review each client's health check and any joint pain they log during a workout.
b: When a client logs joint pain, they appear under Needs Attention and their page shows Needs You at the top. Open the client and tap the pain report to see which exercise, which joint and how bad it was. Swap or change the exercise from their Program if needed, and message them. Tap Mark As Reviewed when you've dealt with it. Scroll to Health Check to read the health information the client shared when they joined. Pain is always shown in yellow, so it stands out without relying on colour alone: it also has its own icon and label.

s: End coaching with a client and free their place for someone new.
b: Open the client from the Clients tab. Scroll to the bottom and tap Remove Client. Confirm. The client keeps their own training history, and their place on your plan is free straight away. A client can also leave you from their Account tab.

s: Chat with each client inside the app: text, photos and replies to their check-ins and form checks.
b: Open the Clients tab and tap Messages. Unread conversations show a number. Tap a client to open the conversation. Type your message and tap Send. Use Tools for quick actions inside the chat, such as Video Call and Form Checks. Community Rules explains what is and isn't allowed in chats. Clients who check in or log pain often send a note with it, so Messages is the quickest way to reply.

s: Call a client from inside the app for a quick catch-up or a form review.
b: Open a client, or their chat. Tap Video Call. The client gets a call notification and joins from their phone. Recent calls are listed so you can see when you last spoke.

s: Clients send a short video of a lift. You watch it and reply with feedback.
b: Open a client and tap Form Checks. New videos are listed first. Tap a video to watch it. Tap Reply To This Form Check and write your feedback. It appears in the client's chat, linked to the video. Videos you haven't watched yet are counted in Needs Attention under Form Checks.

s: Read each client's weekly check-in: scores, answers, body stats and progress photos.
b: Open a client and tap the Check-Ins tab. Each week shows their scores and answers to your check-in questions. Body stats and progress photos sent with the check-in are shown with it. Reply from Messages to give feedback on the week. Set your own questions in Coach Settings › Weekly Check-In Questions.

s: See a client's strength, weekly sets per muscle and personal bests.
b: Open a client and tap the Progress tab. Pick an exercise to see its strength over time. Weekly sets per muscle show how their volume builds through the meso. Personal bests are highlighted.

s: Keep your own meso templates and starter templates ready to customise and assign.
b: Open the Clients tab and tap Programs. Save From Your Mesos turns any meso you've built into a reusable template. Tap Save. Starter Templates are ready-made hypertrophy mesos. Tap Customise to change a template's days, exercises or weeks. Tap Assign to give it to a client.

s: Build or assign a new meso for a client. It appears on their Train screen, branded as yours.
b: Open a client and tap New Meso. Start from a template, or build it day by day: pick the days, then the exercises for each day. Choose how many weeks it runs. A deload week is added at the end. Check it and tap Create. The client sees it as From your business name on their Train screen. Meso Gym is built for hypertrophy: sets and weights progress each week from the client's feedback.

s: Change exercises, sets or days in a client's current meso, or answer their change requests.
b: Open a client and tap the Program tab. Tap a day to see its exercises. Swap an exercise, or change its sets, then save. When a client asks for a change (Request Change), it shows here to accept or decline.

s: See your trainer plan and how many client places you have left.
b: Open the Clients tab and tap Business. Plan And Seats shows your plan (PT Starter, Pro Trainer, Studio or Gym) and how many places are used. When you need more places, move to a bigger tier. PT Starter is you plus 4 clients, Pro Trainer you plus 9, Studio you plus 19. Small Gym is for up to 100 members, Large Gym for one gym with over 100, and Corporate for several locations. Every PT and Gym plan includes Share A Demo.

s: Send a possible client a 1-hour demo of your app, in your branding. No account needed and nothing is saved.
b: Open the Clients tab and tap Business. In Share A Demo, tap Make My Demo Link. Tap Share, Copy Link or Email to send it. Email sends it in your branding. They see a sample client coached by you: your logo, colours, programs, prices and welcome message. Pay is switched off. When the hour ends they see Like It? Join with your name and a button to your invite link. Write a short Welcome Message: it is the first thing they read. Opens and See Visits show how many people tried it and which screens they looked at. Turn Link Off stops the link working. Make New Link replaces it, and the old one stops working. Included in every PT and Gym plan.

s: For a gym with a team of trainers: every member on Meso Gym Pro, in your gym’s branding.
b: Pick a gym plan on the Plans page: Small Gym (up to 100 members) is £180 a month or £1,080 a year, Large Gym (one location, over 100 members) is £260 a month or £1,560 a year. For several locations, ask about Corporate. Add your gym’s logo and colours in Your Brand. Every trainer and every client sees them. Invite your trainers from the Team card in the Business tab. Each joins with their own Meso Gym account. Assign each client to a trainer. Trainers see only their own clients; you see everyone. Connect your gym’s Stripe account: client payments go to the gym, whichever trainer coaches them. Need more than 8 trainers? Extra trainers are about £15 a month each. Studio also has a team: up to 3 trainers and 19 clients. Multi-trainer Gym accounts are being tested now and aren’t in the live app yet. Some Gym-only features are Coming Soon: see Gym Features Coming Soon. Try Demo Gym to see Clyde Strength Gym: 4 trainers and 16 clients.

s: See every trainer, their clients and who needs attention, and move a client to another trainer.
b: Open Demo Gym and go to the Clients tab. Trainers lists everyone in your gym, with their clients and how many need attention. Tap a trainer to see their clients. Tap a client to open them. Use Coached By on a client (or the Trainer menu next to them) to move them to another trainer. Their history, chat and check-ins move with them, and they get a note in their chat. Needs Attention covers the whole gym, so nothing is missed when a trainer is off. Each trainer sees only their own clients. This is checked on our servers, not just hidden on screen. As the owner you can read the messages your trainers send. Multi-trainer Gym accounts are being tested now and aren’t in the live app yet.

s: Add a trainer to your gym with a private invite link, and remove them when they leave.
b: Open the Clients tab, tap Business and find the Team card. It shows how many trainers you have, for example 3 Of 8 Trainers. Tap Invite Trainer. You get a link that works once and lasts 7 days. Share, copy or email the link to your trainer. They open it, sign in with their own Meso Gym account and join your gym. To remove a trainer, tap Remove Trainer on the Team card. Move their clients to another trainer first. A trainer can belong to one gym at a time. To work for another gym they leave yours first (Leave Gym). Cancel an invite you no longer need from the Team card. Studio allows up to 3 trainers; Gym up to 8, and extra trainers are about £15 a month each. Being tested now; not in the live app yet.

s: Choose which trainer coaches each client, and move clients between trainers.
b: On the Team card, tap Assign Clients next to a trainer and tick the clients they coach. Or open a client and use Coached By to pick their trainer. The client gets a short note in their chat saying who their coach is now. Unassigned clients stay with you, the owner, until you assign them. Moving a client keeps their mesos, history, chat and check-ins. Moving many clients at once, and a handover when a trainer leaves, are Coming Soon. Being tested now; not in the live app yet.

t: Working As A Trainer In A Gym
s: What a trainer sees after joining a gym: their own clients, with the gym’s brand and payments.
b: Open the invite link from your gym and sign in with your own Meso Gym account. You get Meso Gym Pro through the gym’s plan, so you can build mesos for your clients. Your Clients shows only the clients the gym assigned to you. Message them, build mesos, review check-ins and track progress as usual. Prices, invites, payments and the gym’s brand are managed by the owner, so there’s no Business tab for trainers. To stop working for the gym, open Account and tap Leave Gym. Client payments go to the gym’s Stripe account. Being tested now; not in the live app yet.

s: What the Gym plan includes now, and what’s on the way.
b: In testing now: owner plus up to 8 trainers, private trainer invites, assigning and moving clients, trainers seeing only their own clients, Leave Gym, your gym’s branding for everyone, and payments to the gym’s Stripe account. Coming Soon, first: an owner dashboard across all trainers, moving clients in bulk, a shared template library for the whole team, and bulk invites (a CSV file or one link). Coming Soon, next: trainer stats and client retention, a manager or front-desk role, member check-in by QR code, classes and group programming, and revenue by trainer. Small Gym is £180 a month or £1,080 a year for up to 100 members. Large Gym is £260 a month or £1,560 a year for one gym with over 100 members. Corporate is £350 a month or £2,100 a year for the first location, plus £175 a month or £1,050 a year for each extra location. Ask us to set it up.

s: Invite a client with a code. They enter it in the app and join you straight away.
b: Open the Clients tab and tap Invite Client (or Account › New Invite Code). Pick the tier the invite is for (for example Full Coaching). Share the code or link with your client. The client signs in, enters the code and appears in Your Clients. Manage Invites shows codes you've sent and lets you cancel one. Codes work once and expire after 7 days.

s: Lifters who find you in Find A Coach can ask you to coach them.
b: Open the Clients tab and tap Business. Coaching Requests lists new requests with a short message from the lifter. Accept to send them an invite, or decline.

s: Set your coaching tiers and prices, for example Programme Only, Full Coaching and Premium.
b: Open Coach Settings › Business › Prices And Payments, then Your Prices. Each tier has a name, a length (for example 1 Month) and a price in £. Tap + Add Price to add a tier, or Remove to take one away. Tap Save Prices. Changing a price applies to new invites and new payments only. Clients already paying keep their price.

s: Take client payments by card through your own Stripe account. Money goes straight to you.
b: Open Coach Settings › Business › Prices And Payments. Under Your Stripe, tap Connect Stripe and follow Stripe's steps to set up your account. Once connected, the status shows as connected with a tick. Tap Manage In Stripe or View Payouts to see your money in Stripe. Add Your Coaching Terms so clients agree to them before paying.

s: See who has paid, ask for a payment and change a client's tier.
b: Open the Clients tab and tap Business. Client Payments shows Paid Up or Payment Due for each client. Open a client and tap Request Payment. They get a payment card in their chat and a notification. Tap Change Tier to move a client to a different price. You're told what happens and when. A failed payment shows under Needs Attention.

s: Refund a client's current payment through Stripe.
b: Open the client from the Clients tab. In their payment panel, tap Refund. Refund only shows for a current paid payment that hasn't been refunded in full. Check the confirm: how much, that it's the whole payment, and what the client loses. Tap Refund to confirm. You see Refund Sent, and their status changes to Refunded once Stripe confirms it. Refunds go back to the client's card through Stripe. You can also manage them in Stripe.

s: Put your logo, business name and colours in every client's app.
b: Open Coach Settings. Under Your Brand, tap Edit. Add your business name and upload your logo. Crop it to fit. Pick your brand colour. Save. Your clients see your name and logo at the top of their app, and their mesos show From your business name.

s: Set up your coach profile and get found by lifters looking for a coach.
b: Open Coach Settings. Under Your Profile, add your photo, a short bio and contact details such as WhatsApp. Under Get Found, tap Find A Coach Listing. Pick your specialities and who you coach, then turn your listing on.

s: Choose the questions your clients answer in their weekly check-in.
b: Open Coach Settings. Under Client Experience, tap Weekly Check-In Questions. Add, edit or remove questions. Each can be a 1 to 5 score or a written answer. Save. Clients see your questions in their next check-in.

s: Your trainer plan includes Meso Gym Pro for your own training too.
b: Open the Train tab to see your own meso. Tap Start Workout to train, just like a client. Your Clients · New Messages at the top takes you straight back to coaching.

s: Your list for today: your workout, your weekly check-in, and optional body stats and photos.
b: Open the Train tab. Things To Do Today is at the top. Each item shows To Do or Done, with a tick when it's done. Tap an item to do it: Today's Workout, Weekly Check-In, Body Stats or Progress Photos. Optional items are marked Optional.

s: Start today's workout and tell the app how sore you are, so it can set your volume.
b: Open the Train tab and tap Start Workout. How Sore Are You? asks about each muscle you're training today: Never Sore, Healed Early, Healed Just In Time or Still Sore. Answer each muscle, then tap Start Workout. Your exercises for the day open, with weights and reps to aim for.

s: Log the weight and reps of every set. Meso Gym suggests what to lift next.
b: In your workout, each exercise shows its sets with a target weight and reps. Do the set, check the weight and reps, then tap the tick to log it. Tap a number to change it if you lifted something different. Skip a set if you need to. It's recorded as skipped, not missed. When every set is done, tap Finish. Your target effort (RIR, reps in reserve) is shown for each week.

s: Can't train today? Skip the workout or move it to another day.
b: Open the Train tab. Tap Can't Train Today? Skip Or Move It. Choose Skip, or move it to another day. Your coach sees it as skipped, not missed.

s: Swap an exercise for today, or ask your coach to change it for the rest of your meso.
b: In your workout, open the exercise card's menu. Tap Swap and pick another exercise for the same muscle. Choose For Today, or ask your coach to change it for the rest of the meso. Your coach is told about the swap.

s: Tell the app, and your coach, when a lift hurts a joint.
b: In your workout, open the exercise card's menu and tap Joint Pain. Pick the joint and how bad it was. The app suggests easing off, and your coach gets a pain report to review. Pain is shown in yellow with its own icon.

s: A few quick questions after each workout set next week's sets and weights.
b: Finish your workout. Answer the questions for each muscle: how hard it was and how your pump felt. Save. Meso Gym uses your answers to set next week's sets.

s: A rest timer between sets, and an interval timer you can turn on in Settings.
b: Open Settings. Under Interval Timer, choose On. In your workout, the timer starts after you log a set.

s: Your coach builds your meso. It shows on your Train screen with their name.
b: Open the Train tab. Your meso shows From your coach's business name. The Weeks grid shows what's done and what's next. Tap Request Change to ask your coach to change something. Tap Mesos on your coach's page to see every meso they've sent you.

s: Chat with your coach in the app.
b: Open the Coach tab, or tap Open Chat on the Train screen. Tap Messages. Type your message and tap Send. A number on the Coach tab means a new reply.

s: Send your coach a short video of a lift for feedback.
b: Open the Coach tab and tap Form Checks. Tap Send A Form Check and record or choose a video. Add a note and send. Your coach's reply appears in Messages.

s: Join a video call with your coach from the app.
b: When your coach calls, you get a notification. Tap it to join. You can also start a call from the Coach tab: tap Video Call.

s: Pay your coach by card in the app, and see what you've paid.
b: Open the Coach tab and tap Payments. Coaching Payments shows your tier, your price and when the next payment is due. When your coach requests a payment, tap Pay and check out securely with Stripe. Agree to your coach's terms the first time you pay.

s: Tell your coach about your health, training experience, goals and week.
b: Open the Coach tab and tap About You (or Settings › Open Health Info). Step 1: Health Info asks about health conditions and injuries. Step 2: Your Training covers your goal, experience, current split, muscles to focus on, equipment, days a week and session length. Tap Save. Your coach sees it on your client page. You can withdraw consent to share health info at any time.

s: Tell your coach how your week went: scores, answers and optional photos.
b: On the Train tab, tap Weekly Check-In under Things To Do Today. Score each question from 1 to 5 and answer any written questions. Tap Add Progress Photos if you want to include them. Tap Send Check-In. Past Check-Ins lists the weeks you've already sent.

s: Take front, side and back photos to see your change over time.
b: Open Progress › Body, then Progress Photos (or the Photos tab). Tap to take or choose a photo for each pose. Compare photos from different dates side by side. Photos are only shared with your coach if you choose to.

s: Log your weight and measurements and see the trend.
b: Open Progress › Body. Choose Centimetres or Inches. Enter your weight and measurements such as waist, then tap Save. Switch between Weight and Waist to see each chart.

s: Strength per exercise, weekly sets per muscle, your Body Map and Power Level.
b: Open the Progress tab. Strength shows each exercise over time. Tap Change to pick another exercise. The Body Map shows which muscles you've trained. Power Level grows as you complete workouts and hit personal bests. Check-Ins shows your past weekly check-ins.

s: Training on your own? Build a hypertrophy meso in a few steps.
b: Open the Plan tab and tap New Meso. Step One: choose the basics: name, weeks and your experience. Step Two: choose how to build it, from a template or day by day. Step Three: check it and tap Create.

s: See your current meso day by day, its weekly sets per muscle and every past meso.
b: Open the Plan tab. Your active meso shows each day and its exercises, plus weekly sets per muscle. Past Mesocycles lists finished mesos. Tap one to see its summary.

s: The last week is a lighter deload. Then you see your meso summary and start the next one.
b: In the deload week, sets and weights drop so you recover. When the last workout is done, Meso Complete shows your results. Start your next meso from it, or wait for your coach to send one.

s: One plan for up to 5 people: you plus 4 invited by code. Everyone trains on their own account.
b: Open Account › Family. Tap Invite to make a code for each person. They sign in on their own phone and enter the code. Remove a member any time to free their place.

s: Theme, units, timer, tips, custom exercises, volume landmarks and backups.
b: Open the Settings tab. Choose your theme and default unit (kg or lb). Add custom exercises and set your volume landmarks. Under Backup, tap Export to save a backup file, or Import to restore one.

t: Your Account And Leaving A Coach
s: Your profile photo, notifications, Pro access and how to leave your coach.
b: Open the Account tab. Upload a profile photo and choose your notifications. Pro Access shows where your Pro comes from, for example your coach. Tap Leave Coach to stop being coached. Your training history stays with you.
